We are expanding our client base and are looking for a motivated, organised individual to support our business development efforts through structured outreach. About the Role This is a one-month freelance engagement focused on lead generation and cold email outreach on behalf of a UK accounting firm. You will be responsible for building targeted prospect lists, executing a structured 3-step email sequence (guidelines and templates provided), and warming leads through to a calendar booking with the firm's director. This is not a high-volume spray-and-pray role. This is structured, professional, targeted outreach to specific types of UK businesses — quality over quantity. You will be sending a maximum of 5 email s per day, scheduled in advance, meaning the role is manageable in a few focused hours per week. Estimated hours: 5–10 hours per week Hourly rate: $5.00 USD per hour Bonus structure: $10 USD for every qualified lead who books a call on the director's calendar (paid after the call takes place). $40 USD for every client who signs up for a monthly bookkeeping or accounting package (paid after the client's 2nd invoice payment is received by the business). If you are good at this, the bonuses will significantly exceed your base pay. (Please note bonuses will not be paid for filling the calendar with time wasters). Your Ideal Client Target - We are looking for UK-registered Ltd companies that fit the following profile: UK Ltd company (London-based preferred, but all UK accepted — international companies with a UK Ltd entity are also valid) Small to medium-sized businesses with relatively straightforward financials Business owners or directors who are actively running their company and would benefit from outsourced bookkeeping, monthly management accounts, and a proactive accountant relationship Industries: professional services, consultancies, agencies, e-commerce, retail, tech startups, and similar The dream client for our business is a small business (£100k+ rev /year) owner who wants clean books, monthly reports, and a knowledgeable firm they can pick up the phone to — on a simple monthly retainer. That is who you are targeting. Key Responsibilities: Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn search, the Companies House API (free), and AI tools Identify newly incorporated UK Ltd companies via Companies House (daily new registrations) Scope job boards (LinkedIn, Indeed, Reed) for businesses advertising for bookkeeping or accounting roles — these are warm leads actively seeking the service we provide Monitor LinkedIn for distress signals — businesses posting about accounting problems, late filings, HMRC issues, or switching providers Execute a 3-step structured email sequence per prospect, following firms provided guidelines and templates Send a maximum of 5 outreach email s per day, scheduled in advance Track all leads, outreach activity, email status, and outcomes in an excel/sheets tracking sheet — every contact must be logged Warm leads through to a calendar booking with firms director Report weekly on activity, pipeline, and results Essential Requirements: Proven experience in business development, lead generation, or cold outreach Strong written English — all outreach is professional and on behalf of a UK accounting firm Comfortable using LinkedIn for prospecting and research Able to use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to assist with list building and research Organised and self-directed — you will be given guidelines and expected to execute independently Reliable, honest, and transparent — all activity must be accurately tracked Desirable: Familiarity with Companies House or UK business registration data Experience with email outreach tools or scheduling platforms (scheduling in Gmail is acceptable). Understanding of UK small business landscape Tools & Access: A business email account will be provided for outreach Primary research tools: LinkedIn search and Companies House API (both free) AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) encouraged for list research and enrichment If a paid tool is genuinely required and clearly justified, this can be discussed — but the expectation is that the role is achievable using free and AI-powered resources A lead tracking sheet will be provided How to Apply Please submit: A brief cover message explaining your experience in lead generation or cold outreach Any examples of previous outreach work or results achieved Any service based busiiness outreach experience Confirmation that you are comfortable working with UK-based business targets and professional email outreach Confirm you will build a spreadsheet that when complete will integrate into our CRM (access provided in future if ongoing contract)

description: Adding outbound sales executives- if incentives based sales is your expertise - let's talk. If you need a lot of hand-holding, this is not the right fit. You must bring all of the following: Fluent, confident spoken English with strong phone presence — both roles will be on live calls. Sales cold calls clients. Ops cold calls and recruits workers in the LA market. Conversations must be natural and impromptu. We use a call guide, not a script. We need people who can reason through problems independently, not freeze. Resourcefulness — search, test, figure it out. Escalate only after you have already tried. Comfort with pressure — early-stage startups are not linear. Priorities shift and timelines compress. Stay sharp regardless. Management potential with hands-on execution — you should be capable of stepping into a lead role while still doing the ground-level work yourself. We are building this together. Long-term orientation — we want people who want to grow with the company, not people looking for short gigs. Role 1: Sales Operator What You'll Do: Research and identify LA-based SMBs — property managers are the primary target Execute cold outreach across email , LinkedIn, and phone — conversational and personalized, never templated Book qualified demos and conduct Loom walkthroughs for prospects Maintain clean, detailed CRM records in HubSpot at all times Document client requirements clearly for Ops handoff after every closed deal Build and refine the sales SOP as you work — you are writing the playbook, not following one You're a Fit If: You can open a cold call without a script and keep a conversation going naturally You have done outbound before and know what actually makes someone respond You think in systems — not just "did I send the email " but "is this sequence working" You are competitive, consistent, and do not need daily motivation from a manager Success Metrics Consistent qualified demos booked weekly HubSpot pipeline hygiene maintained without prompting Clean, detailed handoff notes delivered to Ops after every deal Role 2: Operations Coordinator What You'll Do In the first few months: cold call, reach out, and sign up workers in the LA market — you are building the supply side of the marketplace from scratch via phone and direct outreach Build and execute client onboarding workflows from start to finish Translate what Sales promises into clear, executable delivery steps Coordinate service providers, schedules, and client communications Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and tracking systems in Sheets, Notion, and HubSpot Identify gaps and breakdowns before they become problems You're a Fit If: You are confident and natural on the phone — you will be cold calling real people in the US and convincing them to join a platform they have never heard of You have a bias for documentation — if it is not written down, it does not exist to you You can manage multiple moving parts without a project manager directing your next step You can push back on Sales when a promise is not operationally realistic — professionally and immediately You find broken processes irritating and instinctively fix them Success Metrics Worker recruitment targets met in the first 60–90 days Client onboarding completed within 24–48 hours of deal close Zero client confusion after handoff SOPs updated in real time, not retroactively How You'll Work Together Daily 15-30-minute sync with the Strategic Operations Manager Structured Sales ? Ops handoff required for every client — no exceptions Solve problems together before escalating — your manager is not your first call Joint accountability for client success from close through delivery Compensation Sales Operator: $10–$14/hr based on experience and fit + performance bonuses Operations Coordinator: $8–$12/hr based on experience and fit + performance incentives Both roles: 13th-month bonus (pro-rated) | Leadership growth path for the right candidates HOW TO APPLY (Please read carefully and follow the instructions) Send your application here in Onlinejobs.ph with the subject line: [Role You're Applying For] — Your Full Name (e.g. Sales Operator — Juan dela Cruz). Your application must include: Your cover letter with complete answers to all screening questions below Link to your resume Link to a voice recording - Vocaroo or Speakpipe or any publicly accessible link to a recording of a real outbound call you have made — cold call, follow-up, or recruitment call. No existing recording? Send us a self introduction instead and why you think you're the perfect fit for the role **NOTE: Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. Screening Questions Core Questions — Both Roles Tell us about a time something went wrong while working remotely with a teammate. What did you do, and what was the outcome? A client is clearly unhappy but will not say why. Walk us through exactly how you handle it. What does ownership mean to you in a remote role? Give a specific example. Your teammate's pace is slowing your work down. What do you do? Why do you want to be part of an early-stage startup instead of a stable job — and be honest? Sales-Specific Questions Walk us through how you would research a property management company in Los Angeles before reaching out. Write a 2-sentence cold email to a property manager in LA. No templates — make it feel human. Record a short Loom (2–3 min) explaining what WorkBench does as if you are talking to a prospect for the first time. We are looking for clarity, confidence, and conversational delivery — not a rehearsed pitch. What makes someone actually respond to cold outreach today? What information do you always pass to Operations after a client says yes? Operations-Specific Questions Build a simple onboarding checklist for a new WorkBench client. Show us how you think. How do you make sure nothing falls through the cracks when managing multiple clients at once? What tools do you use for tracking work and why? Don't just name them — explain the logic. Sales promises a client a turnaround that cannot be delivered in that timeframe. What do you do? Everything is urgent. How do you d ---------- what gets done first? You are cold calling a handyman in Los Angeles to sign up on a new platform they have never heard of. You have 60 seconds before they hang up. What do you say? A worker you have been trying to recruit keeps stalling — interested but not committing. How do you follow up without burning the relationship? Pair Evaluation Sales just closed a client. Walk through the exact handoff process step by step. Ops says onboarding will take 3 days. Sales told the client 1 day. Resolve this — live. A client sends completely unclear instructions. Who owns clarification, and how does it get done? How often should Sales and Ops communicate with each other without the manager involved? What is one thing about this opportunity that gives you pause — and how do you think about it? WorkBench is building something real. We want people who are too.

title: B2B Sales Representative
description: B2B Sales Representative Remote (global, English-speaking) · Full-time · 3–5 yrs outbound experience Hears makes premium hearing protection that people actually want to wear. We started because we couldn't find earplugs we'd be caught dead in at a festival, so we spent two years building our own with world-class acoustic engineers and audiologists. The product won an iF Design Award. DJs, producers, and venues trust it. Our B2B side — festivals, clubs, corporates, retail, music industry — has quietly become one of the most exciting parts of the business. It's also the part with the most upside left to capture. That's why we're hiring. The role You're the second pair of boots on the ground for B2B. You'll work directly alongside our B2B Manager, Luuk, and report into the founding team. The job is simple to describe and hard to do well: open new doors, build a pipeline, and close deals. Your day looks roughly like this: - Cold outreach. LinkedIn, email and phone. Real conversations, not blasted templates. You'll be building sequences, testing angles, and getting on calls with people who didn't know they needed us yesterday. - Owning your pipeline. From first touch to signed deal. You'll qualify,send samples, negotiate and close — with full support from us, but you run the process. - Representing Hears. You're often the first human contact a prospect has with the brand. How you write, call and follow up sets the tone. We care about this a lot. - Working five segments: venues & hospitality, festivals & events, corporate wellbeing, pharmacies & retail, and music industry (labels, studios, artist teams). You'll learn fast which ones convert hardest for you and we'll lean in. - Feeding the machine. Clean CRM hygiene, weekly numbers, honest reporting on what's working and what isn't. We don't need theatre — we need signal. - Running the admin side. Keeping the CRM tidy, logging every touchpoint, tracking deal stages honestly, sending samples on time, following up when you said you would. Half of B2B sales is just doing what you said you'd do, on time. We need someone who treats that as part of the craft, not a chore. What we're looking for - Mid-level. 3–5 years of proven outbound sales experience in B2B. We're not hiring on a script — we're hiring on a track record. If you've consistently hit or beaten quota in an outbound role, we want to talk. Specifically: - 3–5 years in B2B sales or business development, with at least two of those running outbound (not just inbound or account management). - Numbers you can point to. Quota attainment, pipeline generated, deals closed, ACV. We'll ask. Bring receipts. - Native or near-native English, written and spoken. Additional languages (Dutch, German, Spanish, French) are a strong plus. - Fluent with the modern sales stack — Notion LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email sequencing tools, Apollo / Lusha / equivalent. -- You don't need to know our exact tools; you need to be the kind of person who learns them in a week. - Comfortable on the phone. A lot of this role still happens on calls. If cold calling makes you flinch, this isn't the right fit. - Self-driven and remote-ready. You'll be working across time zones with a small team. We measure output, not hours — which only works if you're someone who actually runs themselves. - Bonus points for experience in events, music, hospitality, wellness or premium consumer brands. title: Independent Advertising Sales Partner
description: JOB TITLE: Independent Advertising Sales Partner TYPE: Independent Contractor (1099) — Commission-Based LOCATION: Remote · Worldwide (187 Countries) HOURS: Flexible · Set Your Own Schedule START DATE: Immediate · Rolling Applications SECTOR: Digital Media · B2G · B2B · Municipal / Government ABOUT MAYORS & CITIES Mayors & Cities is the premier worldwide municipalities magazine connecting city leaders, government officials, urban planners, and public policy professionals across 187 countries. Published by Secusysts Technologies Inc. (Wilmington, DE, USA), our platform delivers authoritative content on city governance, urban innovation, infrastructure, sustainability, and global municipal cooperation. We serve a highly engaged audience of mayors, deputy mayors, city council members, municipal administrators, and B2G decision-makers — making us one of the most targeted media channels for organizations seeking direct access to city leadership worldwide. THE OPPORTUNITY We are expanding our global advertising sales network and seeking driven, entrepreneurial Independent Advertising Sales Partners to represent Mayors & Cities to advertisers, sponsors, and institutional partners in their regions. This is a remote, commission-based opportunity with no ceiling on earnings. You set your own schedule, work your existing network, and earn competitive commissions on every campaign you close — with performance bonuses for top producers. WHAT YOU WILL DO Prospect and acquire new advertisers across government, NGO, corporate, and institutional sectors Present and sell Mayors & Cities advertising packages: display advertising, sponsored content, newsletter sponsorships, city spotlights, special supplements, and event promotions Manage the full sales cycle, outreach, pitch, proposal, negotiation, close Build long-term relationships with advertisers and renew accounts each cycle Coordinate with the editorial team on campaign delivery and creative assets Submit signed Insertion Orders and ensure smooth campaign onboarding Provide market intelligence and feedback on advertiser needs in your territory ADVERTISING PACKAGES YOU WILL SELL Display Advertising — Banners, sidebar, and in-article placements. Ideal for corporations and NGOs. Sponsored Content — Branded editorial articles. Ideal for governments and development agencies. Newsletter Sponsorship — Email placement directly to city leaders. Ideal for tech and smart-city firms. City Spotlight — Dedicated feature on a city or region. Ideal for city governments and tourism boards. Event Promotion — Conference and summit visibility. Ideal for event organizers and UN agencies. Special Supplement — Thematic branded issue. Ideal for multilateral institutions and corporations. Featured Book / Press Release — Author and organization visibility. Ideal for think tanks and foundations. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Proven track record in media sales, advertising sales, or B2G/B2B business development Existing network in government, public affairs, NGOs, or institutional sectors (a strong asset) Self-motivated, results-driven, comfortable working independently Strong written and verbal communication skills — English required; additional languages a plus Understanding of digital media, content marketing, and advertiser ROI Professional, reliable, representing the Mayors & Cities brand with integrity Familiarity with municipal government or public policy is a significant plus COMPENSATION & COMMISSION STRUCTURE This is a commission-only arrangement. No salary, base pay, draw, or advance is provided. You earn directly from what you close — with no cap on earnings. Commissions are paid on Net Revenue (gross advertising revenue actually received by the Publisher, less any refunds, chargebacks, agency discounts, or authorized deductions) from campaigns closed by you each calendar month, at the following tiered rates: $0.01 — $9,999.99 per month: 20% commission on entire monthly net revenue in this tier. $10,000.00 — $24,999.99 per month: 25% commission on entire monthly net revenue once the $10K threshold is reached. $25,000.00 and above per month: 30% commission on entire monthly net revenue once the $25K threshold is reached. Example: If you close $12,000 in net revenue in a given month, the applicable rate is 25%, resulting in a commission of $3,000 for that month. Additional Terms: Commissions are earned only upon the Publisher's actual receipt of cleared payment from the advertiser. No commission is owed on invoiced but uncollected amounts. The Sales Partner is solely responsible for all costs and expenses incurred in performing services (travel, communications, marketing) unless expressly pre-approved in writing by the Publisher. WHAT WE OFFER Commission rates of 20%, 25%, and 30?sed on monthly net revenue tier No earnings cap — the more you close, the more you earn Full access to Mayors & Cities media kit, rate cards, and sales collateral Dedicated editorial and campaign team support to help you close deals Freedom to work from anywhere in the world on your own schedule The prestige of representing an internationally recognized municipal media brand Potential to grow into a Regional Sales Director role as the network expands NOTE: This is a 1099 Independent Contractor opportunity — not a salaried position. Compensation is exclusively commission-based with no earnings cap. HOW TO APPLY Send your application to: ---------- Subject line: "Sales Partner Application – [Your Name / Region]" Please include: A brief introduction: your sales background and relevant experience Your target territory or region (city, country, or global) Any relevant sector expertise (government, NGO, corporate, media, etc.) Your LinkedIn profile or professional portfolio (optional but recommended)

Describe a time you turned business data into a growth plan that shipped — with the actual outcome. 9. description: We are a U.S.-based performance growth partner working with home service companies. We help our clients scale through paid acquisition, sales optimization, and full-funnel growth systems. We're expanding fast and need a relentless prospector to fuel our pipeline. This is a hybrid role with two responsibilities: 1. Outbound Prospecting: You will research, identify, and contact our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) — home service company owners and operators across the U.S. You'll send personalized outreach, share case studies, follow up relentlessly, and book qualified discovery calls onto the calendar. 2. Inbound Appointment Setting: You will also qualify and set appointments for all new leads coming through our marketing funnel — speed-to-lead calling, qualification, and booking them onto the sales calendar. Your job is to fill the calendar with qualified conversations. The owner takes the actual sales calls — you book them. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Research and build targeted prospect lists of home service operators matching our ICP Send cold outreach via email , LinkedIn, and SMS using approved templates and case studies Personalize outreach at scale — every message references something specific about the prospect Follow up relentlessly — most prospects take 7-15+ touches to respond, and you don't quit until they reply or block you Share case studies, social proof, and success stories at the right ---------- nts in sequences Respond to inbound leads from our funnel within 5 minutes — speed-to-lead is non-negotiable Qualify inbound leads against our criteria and book qualified appointments on the sales calendar Manage CRM hygiene — every contact logged, every interaction tracked, every follow-up scheduled Build and refine outbound sequences in tools like Instantly, Smartlead, Apollo, or similar Report daily on activity (contacts made, replies, booked calls) and weekly on conversion metrics WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 2+ years of experience in outbound sales, appointment setting, SDR, or lead generation Strong written English — your cold email s and LinkedIn messages need to sound natural and professional Strong spoken English — you'll be on the phone with U.S. business owners and need to sound confident Proven track record of booking qualified appointments (be ready to share specific numbers) Familiarity with outbound tools: Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar Familiarity with CRMs: HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Pipedrive, or similar Comfortable with cold calling — you can pick up the phone and stay calm under rejection Relentless follow-up mentality — you don't take "no response" as "no" Self-starter who can operate without micromanagement Reliable internet, quiet workspace, headset, and ability to overlap with U.S. business hours No ego. You'll be doing list building, manual research, and CRM cleanup alongside the high-value work BONUS POINTS: Prior experience prospecting into U.S. home service businesses, contractors, or local service companies Experience selling or setting for high-ticket B2B services Familiarity with home services industry (HVAC, roofing, plumbing, fencing, solar, remodeling, etc.) Experience with Loom or video prospecting Background in agency or marketing services sales Skip tracing, list building, or LinkedIn research experience CULTURE: This is a relentless execution culture. We move fast, we hold each other to a high bar, and we reward results. The metric that matters is qualified booked appointments — that's what gets measured, coached, and rewarded. If you want a chill role, this isn't it. If you want to be on a team where great prospecting is the engine that drives everything else, apply. HOW TO APPLY: Send your application with: A 60-second video introducing yourself in English — pitch us on why we should hire you, as if you were cold-calling a prospect Your average monthly booked appointments in your most recent role (with context: company, industry, deal size) A sample cold email or LinkedIn message you've personally written that got a positive reply (paste it in) Tools you've used for prospecting and CRM Why you want this specific role Applications without a video will not be considered.

description: About Us We're a US-based real estate investment/wholesale company that buys houses directly from homeowners in Ohio. We're a small, fast-moving team and we're hiring a sharp, reliable cold caller to work with us long-term. If you perform well, there's real room to grow — more hours, raises, and lead-based bonuses are all on the table as we scale. What You'll Be Doing You'll call homeowners from a list we provide and follow a simple script. This is NOT a hard-sell role. Our leads are highly targeted — we're calling property owners who match specific criteria, so most of the heavy lifting is done before you ever dial. Your job on each call: Make outbound calls using our dialer (Mojo Dialer — we'll train you) Follow our script (it's short and straightforward) Confirm if the homeowner is open to selling their property Ask two simple qualifying questions: timeframe and price Hand the qualified lead off to me and my partner for the follow-up call Log every call and lead accurately in our system That's the entire role. We handle the deal-making, negotiating, and closing. You're the first voice they hear — we need that voice to sound professional, warm, and confident. What We're Looking For Required: Fluent, clear English with minimal accent — non-negotiable. You'll be speaking with American homeowners, many of them older, and they need to understand you easily on the first try. Confident, friendly phone presence — calm, never pushy Reliable high-speed internet (25 Mbps or higher) and a quiet workspace Quality USB headset with noise cancellation Available 3 hours per day, Monday–Friday, during US Eastern Time business hours Ability to follow a script accurately Strong note-taking and attention to detail Coachable — open to feedback and willing to improve Nice to have (not required): Previous cold calling or telemarketing experience Previous experience in US real estate (wholesaling, acquisitions, or dispositions) Familiarity with Mojo Dialer or similar dialers Familiarity with Podio CRM Why This Role Is Different Most cold calling jobs are brutal — random lists, angry homeowners, hundreds of dials with nothing to show. Ours isn't like that. Our lists are targeted, so the conversations are generally calm. The script is short and we've removed the parts that usually trip new callers up. If you can hold a normal conversation in English, follow a simple flow, and take good notes, you'll do well here. We respect your time. We pay on time. We don't micromanage. We just want someone reliable who shows up, follows the script, and helps us build the pipeline. How to Apply To apply, please send a message that includes: A voice recording (1–2 minutes) of you introducing yourself in English and reading the following two sentences out loud: "Hey Mr. Johnson, this is Mark. I was reaching out to see if you would be interested in selling the house on 1247 Maple Street? Awesome, thank you — while I'm getting your property pulled up, can I ask you a couple of quick questions so I can pass everything along to my partner?" Brief answers to these questions: Do you have previous cold calling experience? If yes, what industry and how long? Do you have previous US real estate experience? If yes, please describe. What is your internet speed? (Please run a quick speedtest.net and tell me the result.) What headset/microphone setup do you use? Are you currently working another job? If yes, are you confident you can commit to 15 hours/week during EST business hours? What time zone are you in, and what hours can you reliably work? ?? Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. This is the most important part of your application. Hiring Process Review of voice recording and written application Short video interview (10-15 minutes) Paid trial week (15 hours, $4/hr) to confirm fit Long-term hire What I Will NOT Tolerate Showing up late or missing scheduled shifts without notice Going off-script or making promises to sellers we can't keep Lying on call notes or skipping leads Heavy accents that homeowners struggle to understand If any of those are issues, this isn't the role for you. But if you're reliable, coachable, and want a stable long-term position with a company that treats you well — apply. Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Remote Solar and Battery Sales Consultant - Australian Company
job_title: Remote Solar and Battery Sales Consultant - Australian Company
description: About Us Unplugged Energy is a dynamic and growing solar energy company based in Perth, Western Australia. We are passionate about helping homeowners switch to clean, renewable energy, saving them money and contributing to a greener planet. As demand for solar and batteries surges in Western Australia, we are expanding our sales team and looking for a motivated professional to join us. The Opportunity This is your chance to build a lucrative career in one of Australia's fastest-growing industries from the comfort of your home. We are seeking a results-driven and passionate Remote Solar & Battery Sales Consultant to join our high-performing team. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, converting warm, inbound leads into happy Unplugged Energy customers. This is not a lead generation role; you will be provided with qualified leads, allowing you to focus on what you do best: building rapport and closing sales. Full training on our products, systems, and the Australian solar and battery market will be provided. What You'll Be Doing You will be responsible for managing the entire sales process, including: -Managing the sales@ email inbox and responding to all new customer enquiries promptly. -Qualifying inbound leads to understand customer needs and project suitability. -Engaging with potential customers via phone (RingCentral) and email . Strong and confident phone communication is essential for building rapport and closing deals. -Educating clients on the financial and environmental benefits of our solar and battery solutions. -Preparing customised, professional proposals using our Open Solar software. -Diligently managing your sales pipeline and recording all customer interactions in our Zoho CRM system. -Working to achieve and exceed sales targets. -Building and maintaining long-term relationships with new and existing clients. What We're Looking For (About You) -A True Closer: You are a professional and dedicated individual with a tenacity for results. You aren't afraid to ask for the sale and have a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets without being pushy, confident yet consultative. -Exceptional Communicator: You must have proficient English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a clear and easily understood speaking voice and you have experience selling to Australian or Western customers and can build trust and rapport quickly over the phone. -Sales Experience: You have a proven track record in a full-cycle sales role, ideally in solar, renewable energy, or another high-ticket industry. You can share specific examples of sales you’ve closed, especially where the customer was hesitant at first. -Maths & Product Knowledge: You’re confident working with numbers to calculate bills, savings, and payback periods on the spot. You can learn and recall product details for multiple brands of solar panels, inverters, and batteries. -Tech-Savvy: You’re comfortable on a computer, confident managing multiple tabs, and quick to learn new software. We will train you on Zoho CRM and OpenSolar, but you must already be comfortable navigating web-based platforms and entering data accurately. -Attitude: You are open-minded, flexible, hard-working, and bring a positive attitude to the team. You are a self-motivated high achiever who can work independently. -Eager to Learn: You have a genuine passion for renewable energy and a drive to stay up-to-date on industry trends and products. -Mindset & Work Ethic: You’re self-motivated, highly organised, and able to manage your own pipeline without constant oversight. You consistently follow through on tasks, keep your CRM clean, and deliver excellent service before, during, and after the sale. Why You'll Love Working With Us -100% Remote: Enjoy the stability of a full-time position from your home office. -Excellent Remuneration: We offer a competitive base salary plus uncapped commissions. Your success determines your income. -Warm, Qualified Leads: We generate our own leads. You will be provided with a steady stream of customers who are already interested in solar and batteries – no cold calling! -A Product That Sells Itself: WA gets more sun than any other state in Australia, meaning our customers produce more power and save more money. With government incentives taking thousands off the cost and the ability to sell excess power back to the grid, solar is an easy decision for customers. -Comprehensive Training & Support: We provide comprehensive training and ongoing mentorship to ensure your success. -You will have full sales, admin, and technical support from our Perth-based team. -Opportunity for Growth: Gain valuable skills and experience in a high-growth industry by working with a supportive and successful team. How to Apply If you are a driven sales professional looking for a stable, long-term remote role, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please send the following: -A short 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and highlighting your sales experience. -Your updated resume and a personality profile if you have one -A short paragraph answering the following question: "Describe your process for taking a new, warm lead from initial contact to a closed sale." -Your expected monthly rate for the base salary component (in PHP or AUD). -Your availability (earliest possible start date). (Applications that do not include all of the above items will not be considered, as it helps us see who has read the full post and can follow instructions.) We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Salesforce Developer
description: This position is open to Philippine residents only. Please do not apply if you are not currently residing in the Philippines. This position requires a night shift schedule and excellent communication skills. The Salesforce Developer designs, builds, and maintains scalable solutions within Rebel Athletic’s Salesforce platform. This role is focused on hands-on development, including Apex, integrations, and system architecture. title: Lead Generation Specialist - Sales Representative
description: PACKAGING INNOVATION INC. & TITAN PACKAGING Lead Generation Specialist Position Type: Remote / Online Target Market: Greater Toronto Area (GTA) Core Objective: Meeting Setting & Pipeline Growth Position Overview Packaging Innovation Inc. and Titan Packaging are leading providers of industrial and commercial packaging solutions. We are seeking a highly motivated, results-driven Lead Generation Specialist to operate remotely and spearhead our B2B outbound prospecting initiatives. The primary objective of this role is to identify high-potential commercial accounts within the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), establish initial contact via professional email and phone outreach, and successfully secure qualified meetings for our regional Business Development Officers (BDOs). This position requires a proactive communicator who understands how to navigate gatekeepers, capture executive interest, and clearly articulate value. Critical Call to Action: Success in this role is measured strictly by the number of highly qualified, confirmed discovery meetings and site-visit appointments successfully booked onto the calendars of our field Business Development Officers. Dual-Brand Portfolios & Segments The specialist will prospect on behalf of two distinct corporate entities, tailoring messaging based on target sector requirements: 1. Packaging Innovation Inc. Focuses on advanced technical packaging, custom consumer clamshell designs, specialized films, and innovative sustainable packaging architectures for modern brands and high-volume manufacturers. 2. Titan Packaging Focuses on industrial-scale supplies, standard logistics packaging, robust manufacturing consumables, bulk corrugated materials, and dependable end-of-line protective packaging structures. Key Responsibilities Outbound Prospecting: Execute daily cold and warm outreach campaigns utilizing multi-channel strategies, primarily focused on targeted professional email s and strategic cold calling. Appointment Setting (The Core CTA): Confidently pitch corporate decision-makers (Logistics Managers, Operations Directors, Procurement Heads, Plant Managers) to secure and coordinate introductory meetings for our GTA-based Business Development Officers. Market Targeting: Research, profile, and cultivate lead lists within the Greater Toronto Area, focusing on manufacturing hubs, distribution facilities, food processors, and e-commerce fulfillment centers. Qualification & Discovery: Conduct preliminary evaluation of prospects to ensure they possess a relevant volume profile, purchasing intent, and infrastructure alignment that warrants a BDO field visit. CRM Data Hygiene: Meticulously log all interaction histories, account details, specific pain points, and scheduled appointment log details within the company CRM system. Calendar Management: Coordinate seamlessly with the BDOs' schedules, ensuring territory routing efficiency and providing comprehensive context briefs prior to every handed-off meeting. Requirements & Qualifications Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of proven success in a B2B appointment-setting, sales development (SDR/BDR), or outbound lead generation role. Experience in industrial supplies, manufacturing, or the packaging sector is highly advantageous. Geographic & Cultural Alignment: Strong familiarity with the industrial layout and corporate landscape of the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) to comfortably converse with local businesses. Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills. Ability to compose concise, persuasive email s and maintain a professional, high-energy phone presence. Tools & Tech Stack: Proficiency with modern sales tools, including CRM platforms, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, automated email sequencing systems, and Google Workspace/calendar coordination tools. Remote Infrastructure: A dedicated, quiet home office environment equipped with high-speed internet, a reliable computer, and a professional-grade headset setup. Autonomy: Highly self-regulated with a track record of meeting daily outbound activity thresholds and weekly appointment targets without direct local supervision. Performance Metrics (KPIs) Number of verified meetings scheduled per week/month for the Business Development Officers. Meeting attendance/show rate of scheduled prospects. Outbound volume metrics (completed calls, personalized email connections delivered daily). Pipeline value conversion (percentage of booked meetings advancing to formal RFQ or project scoping stages).

title: Land Acquisitions Wholesale Real Estate FL
job_title: Land Acquisitions Wholesale Real Estate FL
description: Company Description: We are a forward-thinking real estate investment firm based in Florida, USA. With a proven track record in residential properties, we are aggressively expanding our operations into the lucrative niche of land investing. We are looking for a highly experienced and autonomous Land Specialist to become the cornerstone of our land division. Job Summary: This is a senior-level opportunity for a VA who is a master of the land investment lifecycle. We are not looking for a general real estate assistant; we need an expert who lives and breathes land. You will be the engine room of our Florida land operations, responsible for everything from identifying undervalued parcels to structuring profitable seller financing deals that generate long-term cashflow. Your deep expertise in due diligence and creating notes will be critical to our success. Required Tech Stack (Must Have Experience): ---------- (or sms campaign experience): Daily management of SMS campaigns. PropStream & Zillow: Rapid market research and running comps. County GIS Maps: Navigating local county sites for zoning, parcel boundaries, and utility checks. Bonus Tech Stack (Highly Preferred, but will train): BuyerBridge.ai: Finding builders and managing buyer lists. Id.Land: Property mapping and evaluation. Resimpli CRM: Lead and data management. Land Insights: For advanced property data and evaluation. ---------- : For rapid due diligence and parcel checks. Key Responsibilities: 1. Deal Flow & Acquisitions: * Lead Generation: Implement and manage marketing campaigns to generate a consistent flow of motivated land sellers. * Lead Management: Immediately respond to and professionally handle incoming seller leads on SmarterContact. Filter for motivation and negotiate pricing. * Land Analysis & Comping: Accurately determine the market value of raw land in Florida by rapidly analyzing comparable sales and market data. * In-Depth Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive due diligence on every potential property using GIS and our tech stack, including: * Verifying local Florida zoning regulations and land use restrictions. * Confirming legal and physical access (easements, road frontage). * Investigating utility availability (water, sewer/septic, electricity). * Checking for wetlands, flood zones, topography issues, and other potential restrictions. * Acquisitions: Present offers and negotiate purchase agreements with American sellers, with a strong focus on acquiring properties using seller financing. 2. Seller Financing & Dispositions: * Structure Creative Deals: Architect and structure seller financing (note) terms for both buying land from original owners and selling it to end buyers. * Pitch Seller Financing: Expertly explain the benefits of seller financing to property owners to get more deals accepted over cash offers. * Dispositions & Buyer Relations: Market our land inventory for sale, primarily on terms, to generate cash flow and create valuable paper assets (notes). Utilize BuyerBridge.ai (if familiar) to connect with builders and buyers. * Transaction Coordination: Prepare and coordinate the necessary documents to successfully close on the acquisition and disposition of properties. Qualifications and Experience: Experience: Minimum 2+ years of direct, hands-on experience as a VA specifically in the US LAND INVESTING niche. (This is a strict, non-negotiable requirement). Creative Finance Expertise: Demonstrable expertise in SELLER FINANCING. You must have extensive experience creating, pitching, and structuring notes for both the acquisition and disposition of land. Mastery of Due Diligence: You must know exactly what to look for and what questions to ask to determine a property's true value and usability. Market Knowledge: Familiarity with Florida markets and county zoning sites is highly preferred. Experience with RV Parks or Manufactured Homes is a huge plus. Communication: Fluent English (Speaking and Writing). Exceptional negotiation skills; you must be confident and persuasive when building rapport on the phone. Autonomy: Highly organized, systems-oriented, and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously with zero hand-holding. Bonus: Experience with selling performing notes to third-party note buyers. What We Offer: Premium Compensation: We offer a highly competitive base salary plus a significant performance-based bonus for every profitable deal you manage. Your income is directly tied to the value you create. Leadership Role: You won't be just another VA; you will be a key leader in building our land business from the ground up. Autonomy & Trust: We are looking for an expert we can trust to run the process. You will have the autonomy to make decisions and implement your strategies. Long-Term Stability & Growth: This is a long-term position with a company that is committed to growing and investing in its team. How to Apply: If you are a true Land Investing Specialist who meets these demanding qualifications, we want to talk to you. Do not send a generic cover letter. Please submit your application with a customized cover letter that explicitly answers the following questions: Describe your land due diligence process. What are the top 5 most critical things you look for before recommending the purchase of a rural, vacant land parcel? Explain, as if you were speaking to a property owner over the phone, the benefits for them to sell their land to us using seller financing instead of waiting for a full cash offer. How many years of experience do you have in Land acquisitions and dispositions? Do you have experience with SmarterContact or Launch Control? List one specific Florida county or city you have worked in previously. Have you done any creative financing or seller financing deals? Do you have any experience with subdividing land or doing lot splits? Do you also have experience with houses (not just land)? Applications that do not include thoughtful answers to these 5 questions will be immediately disqualified. This is your chance to prove your expertise. We look forward to reviewing your application!

Pay is $4–5.5/hr to start, with raises based on performance. If accepted, you will be provided with training to help respond to customer queries via phone call, email , live chat, Facebook messenger, & SMS. Please include a link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile and your resume within the email when you apply, then complete the Google form you will receive in an email . Note: After you send the email to apply, you will receive a response fro ---------- with a link to a Google form. Please complete the questions in the Google form to be considered for this position. Forms that are not completed or only partially completed will not be considered. In the form, you will be asked your age. Answer 40 to prove you are paying attention to detail. I look forward to working with you!

description: Summary Vacant Land Real Estate Closer Inbound + Outbound  |  Multi-State Pipeline  | $10-12/hr with experience and track record PLUS Performance-Based Bonuses Job Type Long-term contract, 20 hrs to grow to 40 hrs/week (independent contractor) Compensation Hourly depending on experience + performance bonuses per closed deal (uncapped) Start Date Within 2 weeks of selection Schedule Core hours US Eastern Time (M–F, 9a–5p ET) Markets 22 active states across the Southeast, Midwest, Mid-Atlantic, and Mountain West Reports To Owner / Operator (direct, no middle layer) About Golden Terrain Ventures Golden Terrain Ventures (GTV) is a raw and vacant land acquisition and retail resale business operating in 22 states. The Role We need a veteran closer who lives inside a CRM, treats every lead like a P&L line, and can run a clean script without sounding like one. You will own the lead-to-close pipeline: warm inbound seller calls, structured outbound to qualified lists, follow-up cadences, offer negotiation, contract execution, and buyer-side conversion when called on. You are not a setter. You are not an SDR. You are a closer who also knows how to set, qualify, and nurture because you have done all three for years. You will be the human voice on a heavily systematized pipeline owning the conversations the automation hands you and the ones you generate yourself. What You Will Own • Inbound seller call intake from SMS, voi cemail drops, mailer responses, and website forms • Outbound dials and SMS sequences against pre-vetted, county-validated lead lists • Qualification using GTV's buy box criteria and a standardized discovery framework • Offer presentation, objection handling, and price negotiation within authorized ranges • Contract execution coordination (purchase agreements, addendums, title handoffs) • Buyer-side closing for resale parcels when inventory comes to market • CRM hygiene: every lead status, disposition, next action, and note current within 24 hours • Daily and weekly pipeline reporting against KPI dashboard Required Experience (Non-Negotiable) • Verifiable real estate closing experience — you have closed deals, plural, and can show the receipts. Land experience is a strong plus but not required if your closing track record is real. • Documented closed-deal volume — be ready to show a 12-month deal count, average deal size, and close rate against contacted leads. • Power user of at least one real estate CRM — GHL, REISift, Investorfuse, Podio, Pebble, REI Reply, or equivalent. Tell us which one and for how long. • SMS marketing fluency — you understand 10DLC, A2P registration, opt-out compliance, deliverability, and how to write SMS that gets a reply without getting a number blacklisted. • Scripted call experience with the ability to improvise — you can run a structured discovery, but you know when to throw the script away. • Comfort with virtual close workflows — e-sign, mobile notary coordination, remote earnest money, title company handoffs across multiple states. • Clear, professional spoken English. Neutral or light regional accent acceptable. • Reliable internet, a quiet call environment, and a USB headset (not earbuds). Strongly Preferred • Experience selling parcels under 25 acres in rural Southeast / Mid-Atlantic / Midwest markets • Hands-on experience with GHL (GoHighLevel) as a CRM and Smarter Contact for SMS/dialer • Familiarity with Land Insights, Land ID, PRYCD, or comparable comp/valuation tools • Working knowledge of title issues common to vacant land (vesting deed discrepancies, easements, access, mineral rights) • Buyer-side experience: building a buyer list, qualifying retail land buyers, owner-finance closings • Comfort working inside a documented SOP library rather than freelancing your own process KPIs You Will Be Measured On These are the numbers reviewed weekly and tied to performance bonuses. Misses two months in a row trigger a written improvement plan; three months trigger separation. Activity KPIs (Weekly) Metric Target How Measured Outbound dials per day 80 minimum Smarter Contact dialer logs Live seller conversations / week 25 minimum GHL dispositions: 'Live Conversation' or higher SMS replies handled / week 100% within 4 business hours Smarter Contact response timestamps Inbound seller call answer rate ? 85% GHL / phone system reports CRM data hygiene 100% Every touched lead has updated status, disposition, notes, and next-action date within 24 hrs Pipeline KPIs (Monthly) Metric Target How Measured Qualified leads generated 40+ /month GHL stage: 'Qualified' (meets buy box) Offers sent 20+ /month Signed offer documents in GHL Offer-to-contract conversion ? 25% Executed PSAs / offers sent Contract-to-close conversion ? 80% Closed deals / executed PSAs Closed acquisition deals 3+ /month by Day 90 Funded and recorded Performance Bonuses Compensation is intentionally weighted toward performance. Strong closers earn well above their hourly base. Bonuses are paid the Friday after a deal funds — no waiting on quarterly resets. • Per-Deal Bonus (Acquisition): Tiered structure that scales with monthly closed-deal count. The more you close in a month, the higher the per-deal payout — and tier bumps apply retroactively to every deal closed that month. • Per-Deal Bonus (Resale): Flat bonus on cash sales, plus trailing payments on owner-finance sales for on-time buyer performance, plus stacking bonuses on multi-parcel packages. • Margin Bonus: Additional bonus per deal when your closed acquisitions average at or below 60% of Top Market (per GTV formula). • KPI Streak Bonus: Lump-sum bonus for hitting every weekly activity KPI for 12 consecutive weeks. • Big Deal Bonus: Bonus tied to net profit on any closed deal exceeding a defined profit threshold. • Quarterly Performance Bonus: Additional performance bonus paid quarterly based on overall pipeline contribution and KPI consistency. Specific bonus amounts and structure are detailed in the offer letter at hire. Tech Stack You Will Use • CRM: GoHighLevel (GHL) • Dialer & SMS: Smarter Contact • Valuation & Comps: Land Insights, Land ID • Document Execution: GHL (e-sign and contract management) • Knowledge Base: Claude AI (SOPs, scripts, objection library, deal analysis) • Data Layer: Google Apps for Business (Drive, Sheets, Docs) • Communication: Slack, GHL, and Smarter Contact How to Apply We read every proposal. Generic copy-paste applications go straight to the bottom of the stack. To be considered, your proposal must include the following — in this order: 1. The Header Start your proposal with the word LAND on the first line. This confirms you read the post. Applications without it are auto-rejected. 2. Your Track Record • Years closing real estate deals (specify land vs. residential vs. commercial) • Closed deal count in the last 12 months • Average deal size (acquisition price, resale price, or both) • States or regions you have closed in • Lead-to-close conversion rate (your honest number — we will verify the math) 3. Your Stack • CRMs you have used as a daily driver and for how long • SMS platforms you have run, with rough monthly send volume • Dialer experience (manual, power, parallel) 4. A Live Sample Pick ONE of the following and include it directly in your proposal: • A 60–90 second voice memo of you walking through an opening seller call (no real PII) • Your written discovery script for a cold inbound vacant land seller • A short write-up of the toughest objection you have closed against and exactly how you handled it 5. Two Questions, Answered Briefly • Q1: A seller verbally accepts your offer on Tuesday. By Friday, they are not returning calls or texts. What is your exact next-72-hours plan? • Q2: You discover at title that the deed vesting does not match the seller as listed. The seller wants to close in two weeks. How do you keep the deal alive without overstepping the title company? What Working Here Looks Like You will not be micromanaged. You will be measured. The pipeline, the data, the scripts, and the systems are already built — your job is to close. If you are the kind of closer who gets restless when leads sit in a queue and who feels physically uncomfortable when a CRM stage is out of date, you will fit in here. If you need someone behind you holding a stopwatch, this is the wrong seat. Long-term, the right person becomes the lead voice of GTV acquisitions and resale and earns into a senior tier with profit-sharing on originated deals. The ceiling here is what you make it.

title: Full Cycle Sales Rep
description: This is not an appointment setting job. This is not a lead generation job. This is a fullcycle sales role, meaning you own the entire process from the first outreach to the signed agreement. You will prospect, qualify, book, run the call, handle objections, and close the deal yourself. You will be the most important person on this team. Every dollar this company makes in the first 30 days goes through you. We are a new US-based company offering high-ticket B2B services to business owners. We are hiring a support team that handles lead research and outreach, but you will also be expected to source your own pipeline. You are not waiting for leads to be handed to you; you are a hunter who also knows how to close. You will prospect for new clients using any other channel that you are comfortable with. You will qualify prospects by asking direct questions about their business pain and their budget. You will book discovery calls onto your own calendar and run those calls on video. You will present the solution clearly, handle every objection, and ask for the close. You will follow up relentlessly until the deal is won or definitively lost. You will track every deal, every conversation, and every follow-up inside our CRM. There is no hand-holding. You will be given the tools, the training, and the offer. The rest is on you. Tools We Will Provide: GoHighLevel CRM — for managing your full pipeline, tracking deal stages, and scheduling follow-ups Calendly — for booking discovery calls directly from your outreach You must be fully operational inside GoHighLevel within your first week. Within 30 days, you must have a live pipeline with active deals in progress and at least one deal closed or in final negotiation. If you cannot demonstrate real closing activity within 30 days, this role is not the right fit. What We Are Looking For: You have closed B2B deals before; not just set appointments, not just generated leads, but actually closed. You are comfortable on video calls with US business owners. Your English is professional and near-native. You are not afraid to ask direct money questions. When a prospect stalls, you do not fold, you re-qualify and reengage. You are self-motivated, organized, and hungry. You treat your pipeline like a business, not a task list. Confident on video calls: camera on, professional background, clear audio Near-native English speaking and writing ability Comfortable with silence after the close Available Mon–Fri during US Eastern business hours (9am–5pm EDT) Compensation & Growth: Your base pay and your commission rate both increase as your performance increases. In the beginning, this is just a probationary period. You may not be a strong fit for the job. But once you prove that you are the person that I can't move forward without, where pay will increase exponentially. In the beginning, there is a starting base of $3/hr + 10% commission on every closed deal. Once you prove that you're the one for the job, it goes to $10/hr + 15% commission; this can happen in a matter of days depending on how well you perform. When you continue to excel, you get 20% commission and a 3k a month base salary. From there your salary will increase annually. Your earning potential is entirely in your hands. You do not wait for a raise. When you perform at the highest level, you are rewarded for it, because you deserve it. Eventually you will have a staff to work under you, and at that point your monthly base salary will be upwards of 5k a month, and you will still have your commissions.
